items.name: ForestTurkey
items.visual_note: Viewed six images: final runtime_r01/four_directions.png, runtime_visual_strip.png, existing playback_review_r01.png, and three new summaries composed from native GIF phases. The turkey has a round ochre-brown spotted belly, a pale gold long neck and wattle, and a five-feather rounded fan with gold bands and pale taupe tips. The front shows two eyes and a beak; the back shows only the back of the head and neck, with the centered tail fan covering much of the torso. Folded wings join both sides and two thin legs remain attached below the belly; no detached or duplicated limbs are visible. Up/Down native phase samples show alternating foot positions and a small body bob; turning samples retain the original side-view stride, and no ground shadow is visible in the inspected directions or action samples. Attack samples show angry front eyes followed by the normal face; hurt flashes white then recovers. The two death sequences show front/back sideward collapse, shrinking and progressive fade, followed by reuse with the normal front face and opaque body restored. Pause/speed samples retain the rear fan and connected legs. This was a six-summary-image visual review, not a new Play run or an exhaustive frame-by-frame review; pause/speed timing and same-instance reuse are separately supported by the existing two 84-check runtime reports. User art approval remains pending.

items.name: Ghost
items.visual_note: Inspected the final four_directions and runtime_visual_strip plus sampled GIF timelines for Up/Down floating, turns, attack/death/reuse and pause/speed. Ghost has a white rounded sheet body, restrained beige side shading, ochre oval eyes and small mouth on the front, and a plain faceless rear. The final continuous upper-sheet/hem composite has no horizontal body gap; two short side flaps attach under the side outline, with no invented legs, bat wings or ground shadow. Floating poses show small changes in height and side flaps; turns switch between preserved original side art and the new front/rear, and front attack briefly shows slanted eyes and a fang mouth while the back stays faceless. The Up death sequence visibly flashes white, turns gray, tips sideways and fades progressively; reuse restores an opaque normal front and green health bar. Pause/speed samples retain the complete silhouette. Both real Play revisions passed 84 checks each, 680 recorded frames total. User art approval remains pending. Six image boards/views were actively inspected; no claim of continuous GIF playback.

items.name: Goat

Goat retains its white/cream coat, round ochre spots, short banded horns, lateral pointed ears, chin beard on the front, four hooves and small raised tail; the rear is faceless with no exposed beard or invented central dorsal tuft. The revised head covers the neck cut surface and the rounded leg roots overlap the torso; fore/hind feet remain connected in the observed phases. Up/Down samples show alternating hoof positions and restrained body/ear/tail movement; turns retain the original side silhouette, and no ground shadow is visible in the inspected movement, attack, death and reuse samples. The front attack sample has narrowed angry eyes, hurt shows white flash then normal color, both death sequences tip sideways and shrink/fade, and reuse restores the normal opaque front and green HP bar. Pause and speed samples retain the connected rear silhouette; timing and same-instance reuse are separately supported by the two actual Play reports, 84 PASS/0 FAIL each, 683 frames total. Native GIF timelines were decoded and their phases summarized in one board; this is not a claim of continuous UI playback or exhaustive frame-by-frame visual inspection. User art approval remains pending.
